taxonomyMetadata.scope: Controlled taxonomy for archive-wide exchange and passage classification across Q1 to Q5

governanceRules.consolidationCriteria: Candidate labels must represent distinct operational mechanisms with zero semantic redundancy. Synonymous or overlapping lexical clusters from the initial 54-group NMF catalog are consolidated into cohesive technical and operational domains. Conversational filler clusters are filtered out of substantive domains.
governanceRules.disambiguationRules: Passages must be evaluated across independent orthogonal dimensions. Substantive topics (Q1), corrective interactions (Q2), assistant assumptions (Q3), longitudinal shifts (Q4), and interpersonal layers (Q5) must never be conflated.
governanceRules.diagnosticTermPolicy: Strict prohibition of clinical diagnosis. Diagnostic labels (such as BPD) are recorded solely as reported narrative terms with full speaker and citation provenance.
governanceRules.unassignedFallbackHandling: Passages lacking clear criteria alignment must be tagged with 'unassigned_ambiguous' or 'insufficient_context' rather than forced into mismatched categories.

dimensions.description: Substantive technical projects and creative investigations outside relationship material.

labels.definition: Engineering of computational architectures, state machines, workflow transitions, and structured modular systems.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Exchanges specifying state transitions, control loops, execution procedures, CommonJS/ESM modules, or repository state control.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Generic, unconstrained software discussions or basic syntax lookups.

labels.definition: Investigations of physical acoustics, resonator chambers, airflow mechanics, and mechanical silencing systems.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Discussions of Helmholtz resonators, airflow speed, noise attenuation, volumetric flow rate, or dimensional constraints.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Consumer audio purchasing queries or casual music playback setups.

labels.labelName: Commercial Food Business Operations & Culinary Infrastructure
labels.definition: Commercial kitchen operations, food preparation infrastructure, commercial equipment, and operational planning.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Equipment specifications (mounted thermometers, cold storage), commercial food preparation, licensing, or vendor sourcing.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Routine home cooking recipes or personal diet tracking.

labels.labelName: Agile Sprint Modeling & Procedural Artifact Generation
labels.definition: Custom procedural project management modeling, sprint planning frameworks, and task boundary definitions.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Custom sprint cadence formulation, input/output boundary rules for deliverables, and procedural sprint modeling.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Theoretical Scrum Guide debates lacking concrete structural workflow artifacts.

labels.labelName: Creative Writing, Worldbuilding & Sci-Fi Concept Design
labels.definition: Fictional worldbuilding, narrative character profiles, sci-fi military hierarchy design, and creative script revisions.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Exchanges focusing on narrative prose, character backstories, speculative military structures, or fictional world designs.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Professional resume drafting, marketing copy, or personal interpersonal communications.

labels.definition: Inquiries into administrative records, statutory birth certificate rules, legal documentation, and regulatory filings.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Jurisdiction-specific statutory document issuance rules, official record retrieval procedures, or regulatory verification.
labels.exclusionCriteria: General web lookups lacking statutory or administrative record focus.

dimensions.description: User turn-by-turn operational directives, negative feedback constraints, and assistant adaptations.

labels.definition: User repudiates a factual assumption, narrative framing, or premise introduced by the assistant.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Direct statements that an assistant claim or assumption is false, inaccurate, or off-base.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Minor formatting preferences that do not challenge baseline premises.

labels.definition: User restricts the operational boundary, removes superfluous offerings, or enforces negative constraints.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Explicit removal of draft elements, tightening of functional boundaries, or instructing the model to omit extra material.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Open-ended brainstorming that expands scope.

labels.definition: User demands primary sources, statutory citations, or external verification for assistant claims.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Demands for corroborating statutes, authoritative citations, or challenges to model authority.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Uncritical acceptance of model assertions.

labels.definition: User enforces sequential, gated execution instead of all-in-one generic generation.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Directives requiring the assistant to take one step at a time, check prerequisites, and wait for confirmation.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Requests for broad, unstructured conversational summaries.

labels.definition: User commands explicit syntactic, structural, or stylistic constraints (e.g. JSON-only, tables, concise tone).
labels.inclusionCriteria: Directives dictating strict output formatting, schema compliance, or elimination of conversational boilerplate.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Factual corrections to domain subject matter.

dimensions.description: Assistant-introduced premises, hallucinations, unsolicited framing, and downstream conversational influence.

labels.definition: Assistant introduces clinical, diagnostic, or psychological interpretations without explicit user instruction.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Assistant labeling third-party conduct as borderline, narcissistic, manipulative, or trauma-driven without user prompting.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Assistant providing objective clinical definitions upon explicit user request.

labels.definition: Assistant presents engineering rules-of-thumb, legal requirements, or domain heuristics as objective facts without verification.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Asserting specific technical tolerances, decibel values, or legal mandates without qualifying uncertainty or citing sources.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Statements of well-known universal mathematical or physical formulas with explicit caveats.

labels.definition: Assistant uncritically validates subjective user claims or emotional biases, escalating the premise downstream.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Assistant echoing speculative user theories about other people's motives or technical superiority without critical balance.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Neutral validation of emotional distress or objective computational verification.

labels.definition: Assistant confidently advises on visual or physical arrangements that are ungrounded due to absent attachment payloads.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Making definitive claims regarding physical dimensions or layouts based on non-accessible image attachments.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Reasoning strictly grounded in dimensions explicitly typed by the user.

dimensions.description: Longitudinal usage patterns across verified empirical date strata.

labels.definition: Early adoption mode (2024-08-25 to 2024-12-31) focused on open exploration, informational queries, and conversational advice.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Short prompts, conceptual queries, conversational advice-seeking, and low constraint density within 2024 timestamps.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Complex procedural state machine orchestration or rigid schema enforcement.

labels.labelName: Period 2: Operational Systems Design & Iterative Co-Creation
labels.definition: Established operational work (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31) focused on sustained multi-turn workflows, business drafting, and engineering.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Multi-turn iterative development, operational planning, and systematic corrective pushback within 2025 timestamps.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Brief one-shot informational queries or late-stage automated state machine procedures.

labels.labelName: Period 3: Rigorous Procedural Orchestration & State Machine Enforcement
labels.definition: Mature integration mode (2026-01-01 to 2026-08-05) focused on formal constraint enforcement, supervisory review, and schemas.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Procedural state machine design, JSON data-contract enforcement, rigorous verification checks within 2026 timestamps.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Unstructured emotional venting or early onboarding queries.

labels.definition: Interaction behaviors and preferences that remain stable and invariant across all chronological periods.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Consistent preference for direct answers, structured tables, and immediate factual correction across all periods.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Behaviors restricted to an isolated period.

dimensions.description: Four-layer multi-perspective interpersonal interaction framework separating quotes, event reports, subjective reactions, and narrative diagnoses.

labels.definition: Verbatim reproduction of messages, transcripts, or utterances sent or spoken directly by a third party.
labels.inclusionCriteria: User quotes verbatim SMS, chat messages, or dialogue spoken by another person, enclosed in quotes or transcript blocks.
labels.exclusionCriteria: User summaries, emotional reactions, or paraphrases of third-party statements.

labels.labelName: Epistemic Layer 2: User Retrospective Event Report
labels.definition: User reporting observable physical occurrences, logistical events, or chronological actions involving others.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Factual narration of incidents, movements, timeline occurrences, or physical interactions involving others.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Inferences about internal emotional motives or psychiatric evaluations of others.

labels.labelName: Epistemic Layer 3: User Subjective & Affective Reaction
labels.definition: User expressing personal feelings, stress, emotional exhaustion, or boundary decisions in response to interactions.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Expressions of the user's personal emotional state, internal conflict, distress, or personal resolution.
labels.exclusionCriteria: External physical event logs or assertions regarding third-party diagnostic status.

labels.definition: Assistant-generated psychological analyses, personality assessments, or interpersonal boundary recommendations.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Assistant turns interpreting interpersonal dynamics, attributing personality patterns, or counseling boundaries.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Direct quotes from third parties or user raw factual reporting.

labels.definition: Explicit occurrence tracking of diagnostic or clinical terms within transcripts, tagged with provenance and non-clinical status.
labels.inclusionCriteria: Any transcript occurrence of terms such as borderline personality disorder, BPD, or narcissism, tagged with speaker and node ID.
labels.exclusionCriteria: Colloquial non-diagnostic descriptions of moods or ordinary relationship disagreements.
